record.name: Zoho Cliq
record.one_liner: Zoho Cliq offers team chat, online meetings, communication tools, and a REST API authenticated via OAuth 2.0.

auth.notes: Zoho APIs are authenticated using the OAuth 2.0 standard, supporting various app types and self client option.

access.notes: You can create a free account to get started and register your application in the API console to obtain credentials.
